functions.name: cloud_novel_position
cloud_novel_url
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION mangaro_private.cloud_novel_url(source text, value text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select coalesce(char_length(value) between 1 and 4096 and value ~ (
 '^https://([a-zA-Z0-9-]+\.)*' || case source
 when 'novel.kolnovel' then 'kolnovel\.com' when 'novel.cenele' then 'cenele\.com'
 when 'novel.sunovels' then 'sunovels\.com' when 'novel.seanovel' then 'seanovel\.org'
 else '(?!)' end || '(:443)?(/|$)'),false);
$function$

constraints.name: cloud_novel_progress_check2
constraints.definition: CHECK (COALESCE(((jsonb_typeof(state) = 'object'::text) AND (octet_length((state)::text) <= 65536) AND (state ?& ARRAY['position'::text, 'bookmarked'::text]) AND ((state - ARRAY['position'::text, 'bookmarked'::text]) = '{}'::jsonb) AND (jsonb_typeof((state -> 'bookmarked'::text)) = 'boolean'::text) AND mangaro_private.cloud_novel_position(source_id, (state -> 'position'::text), chapter_url)), false))

constraints.name: cloud_novel_progress_user_id_edition_key_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (user_id, edition_key) REFERENCES cloud_novel_state(user_id, edition_key)

constraints.name: cloud_novel_progress_user_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: cloud_novel_progress_user_id_source_id_edition_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (user_id, source_id, edition_id) REFERENCES cloud_novel_state(user_id, source_id, edition_id)

constraints.name: cloud_novel_state_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((("left"(edition_id, (char_length(source_id) + 1)) = (source_id || ':'::text)) AND mangaro_private.cloud_novel_url(source_id, SUBSTRING(edition_id FROM (char_length(source_id) + 2))) AND (edition_key = encode(sha256(convert_to(edition_id, 'UTF8'::name)), 'hex'::text))))

constraints.name: cloud_novel_state_check1
constraints.definition: CHECK (COALESCE(((jsonb_typeof(state) = 'object'::text) AND (octet_length((state)::text) <= 65536) AND (state ?& ARRAY['saved'::text, 'favorite'::text, 'readingStatus'::text, 'lastPosition'::text, 'title'::text, 'cover'::text, 'addedAt'::text]) AND ((state - ARRAY['saved'::text, 'favorite'::text, 'readingStatus'::text, 'lastPosition'::text, 'title'::text, 'cover'::text, 'addedAt'::text]) = '{}'::jsonb) AND (jsonb_typeof((state -> 'saved'::text)) = 'boolean'::text) AND (jsonb_typeof((state -> 'favorite'::text)) = 'boolean'::text) AND ((state ->> 'readingStatus'::text) = ANY (ARRAY['reading'::text, 'completed'::text, 'planned'::text])) AND (jsonb_typeof((state -> 'title'::text)) = 'string'::text) AND ((char_length((state ->> 'title'::text)) >= 1) AND (char_length((state ->> 'title'::text)) <= 512)) AND (((state -> 'cover'::text) = 'null'::jsonb) OR ((jsonb_typeof((state -> 'cover'::text)) = 'string'::text) AND (char_length((state ->> 'cover'::text)) <= 4096))) AND (COALESCE((state ->> 'addedAt'::text), ''::text) ~ '^[0-9]{1,16}$'::text) AND mangaro_private.cloud_novel_position(source_id, (state -> 'lastPosition'::text))), false))

constraints.name: cloud_novel_state_user_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
